lines.narration: In this town, the number over your head is the bounty on your life.
My number said zero. Everyone laughed.
Until the Red Purge sirens blared.
And every steel door in town slammed shut.
So I ran door to door, screaming.
Please — the monsters are right behind me. My face never moved.
Worth zero means harmless. Armed neighbors stepped out to enjoy the show.
The last door clicked open. I stopped running.
And peeled the zero off my head.
The monsters were never hunting me. They were here to collect.
Monsters can't break steel doors. They just needed someone dumb enough to beg them open.
